references.text: The prophecy of a virgin who will give birth to a son, pointing forward to the birth of Jesus.
God's promise to Abraham that all nations on earth would be blessed through his offspring, suggesting Jesus' work of salvation.
Hosea's prophecy that God will call his Son out of Egypt, which can also be seen in light of Jesus' mission of salvation.
The psalm that speaks of God's redemption of Israel from their sins, foreseeing Jesus' role in saving his people from their sins.
A direct reference to the name of Jesus and his mission to save his people from their sins.
